configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Full-featured debug build for daily development. Warnings are errors here (and in tsan and ci, which inherit this) so a new one fails where it is introduced; pass -DSENCHA_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=OFF to get past one in progress.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build. Hot-reload stays off -- shipping binaries carry no GLSL compiler. Warnings stay warnings: optimizer-dependent diagnostics vary with the compiler version, and a toolchain upgrade must not be able to block a shipping build. The dev preset is where they gate.

configurePresets.name: profile
configurePresets.description: Release optimization with symbols and frame pointers, so profiler attribution maps to shipping code shape. Cycle and cache counts taken from a Debug build do not describe the shipping binary.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with ThreadSanitizer for the job system's concurrent core.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with AddressSanitizer. The suites worth running here are the ones that decode untrusted bytes into fixed-size storage -- the replication codec above all, where a field's declared width and the width the codec touches are separate facts that have to agree.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: Build + test config for CI. Needs the Vulkan SDK headers on the runner; no GPU required to build/run the (non-graphical) test suite. A headless no-Vulkan build is not yet supported -- the render layer still includes Vulkan headers unconditionally.
